slot.brief: Ask the number of octahedral and tetrahedral voids per unit cell / per atom in an fcc lattice.

stem: An fcc unit cell contains how many octahedral voids and tetrahedral voids, respectively?

verdicts.working: An fcc unit cell has 1 octahedral void at the body centre plus 12 edge-centre voids shared by 4 cells: 1 + 12/4 = 4. It has 8 tetrahedral voids fully inside the cell.

working:
fcc contains $4$ lattice atoms per unit cell.
Octahedral voids $=4$; tetrahedral voids $=2(4)=8$.

Independent check: An fcc unit cell has 1 octahedral void at the body centre plus 12 edge-centre voids shared by 4 cells: 1 + 12/4 = 4. It has 8 tetrahedral voids fully inside the cell.
solution:
An fcc unit cell contains $4$ lattice atoms. The number of octahedral voids equals the number of atoms, while tetrahedral voids are twice that number:
$$N_{\text{octahedral}}=4,\qquad N_{\text{tetrahedral}}=2(4)=8.$$
